subject: Ventus Health: demo fallback plan & procurement timing

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>

Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, Oct 5, 2026 at 9:12 AM PDT
Subject: Ventus Health - demo fallback plan (GCP outage + SE travel)

Hi Alex,

Quick heads-up: we saw the GCP regional maintenance yesterday (your team mentioned the incident) and our SE, Stephanie, just flagged an unavoidable travel commitment on 10/6–10/8. Between the platform instability and her travel, I want to propose a fallback plan so we don't lose momentum.

Options I propose (short):
- Option A (preferred): Split the session into two parts this week — a 30-min architecture + security review (remote) on Thursday 10/8 morning PT and a hands-on walkthrough (recorded or live with backup SE) the following week.
- Option B: Keep a single 90-min session but move to Wed 10/7 afternoon PT; Monica can cover most hands-on bits if Stephanie is unavailable.
- Option C: Record a focused demo and follow with a short live Q&A for the core stakeholders.

Logistics / asks for your side:
- Can procurement confirm PO timing? If PO/contracting takes 1–2 weeks, we can prioritize a short architecture session now and defer hands-on.
- Will your security team need an on-call engineer present for the walkthrough? If so, please share any specific checklist items they want us to cover.

I've attached a draft agenda and a mutual action plan (MA). If you prefer, I can send calendar hold suggestions once you tell me which option is best.

Attachments: ventus-demo-agenda.pdf, ma-plan-v1.docx

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | (415) 555-0147
From: Alex King <alex.king@ventushealth.com>

Date: Mon, Oct 5, 2026 at 10:02 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Ventus Health - demo fallback plan (GCP outage + SE travel)

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the proactive plan. Quick replies: 

- Procurement: contracts@ventushealth.com here. We're aiming to have PO approval by 10/20 but need final SOW language clarified (a couple of custom terms). I'll escalate but cannot promise earlier than 10/20.
- Security: we need a short checklist. Key items: data residency guarantees, audit log retention, and the VPC setup you support. We prefer the architecture review first so we can validate controls before any hands-on demos.

So Option A (split session) sounds right to us. Can we do the architecture call Thu 10/8 10:00–10:30 AM PT? If Monica will cover hands-on, that works — otherwise we'll pause the hands-on until we have contracts in place.

Alex King
